about: The home page, as one noun, following the Agora-Home board of October 31, 2026: the film first (one or more cuts, with a default), then Start here with the two public sites, then the decks, then the use cases. The start part's heading is the page's heading. scripts/build_site.py renders it into site/index.html. The film's production page is linked only once its production trace is final (film_made).
title: Agora, the ta-amps overview
description: Agora is the ta-amps overview: the three-minute film, where to start, five decks and the use cases. The use case is Eranos, spare tokens for good. Underneath sits Tessera, a shared durable task queue and task objects store where independent agents claim durable tasks and publish task objects.
